item.tib: bstan srung brag btsan dmar po'i brtan 'dzugs mdung bstod kyi rim pa
item.coloph: bstan srung brag btsan rgyal po'i rten 'dzugs mdung bstod 'di ni/ rgyal chung mi yi dbang po btsan rgyal grags pa'i/ bka' yis bskul bar brten/ dus mtha'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis sbyar ba'o//
